verified_features.summary: Local Signage runs a local browser control console on the Android device.
The web console can upload image and video files and immediately play a single item or create a playlist for multiple files.
The player supports image, video, live stream, web, and text content modes.
Devices can be discovered on a local network through NSD and UDP fallback.
A paired device can receive an assigned playlist through the local control API.
Playback infrastructure runs in a foreground service and is restarted after boot or app updates.
Locally uploaded media is stored on the Android device and played from local files; playback state is restored when the player initializes.
